says: Today's lead skill says clauderow writes the field row of a `--agent claude` box, but no script starts clauderow.
proof: `rg -n clauderow .agents -g '!*.md'` at this head prints only clauderow's own two files and one comment in agents.ts:536. drive.ts:1426 writes each step's row itself with `stepRow` from agents.ts, for a Claude box too. The ticket this was found on, 593, also says chain.ts and drive.ts start it with python3, which was no longer so.
cost: A lead who trusts the sentence may look for a clauderow row that never comes, or run clauderow by hand on a box whose row drive already wrote, and log the run twice.
